user.title: AigoSmart account (unofficial integration)
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the AigoSmart app.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: A verification code was sent to your email. Enter it to continue.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Devices in pairing mode found via Bluetooth and WiFi. Put your device in pairing mode first (usually by holding its power button for 5 seconds).

wifi.title: WiFi credentials
wifi.description: Enter the WiFi network the new device should join. Provisioning happens over Bluetooth (works via ESPHome bluetooth proxy).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect / login failed. Check your credentials.
error.unknown_device: Selected device is no longer visible.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed. Make sure the device is still in pairing mode and near the Bluetooth adapter/proxy, then try again.

abort.not_loaded: The AigoSmart integration must be set up first.
abort.no_devices_found: No Aigostar devices in pairing mode were found. Hold the device's power button for ~5 seconds and try again.
